whatWasWrong: Portable options files longer than the fixed H8CF container could be accepted by truncating the read view.
Future options file versions greater than the current FileVersion could be parsed as if they were the current binary format.
Legacy option record fields were read with an unscoped property search, allowing nested spoofed fields or malformed value suffixes to be treated as valid.
An intermediate optional-property helper could not distinguish a missing optional field from an invalid duplicate field.
whatChanged: TryReadPortableOptionsFile now rejects version <= 0 and version > FileVersion.
Legacy record objects are bounded by the validated Records array range.
Legacy record fields are read only through top-level property ranges.
String, int, float, and bool legacy values now require full value-token consumption.
Optional legacy fields now separate valid/not-found from malformed/duplicate state.
Dead unscoped legacy property helpers were removed.
